name: Convex-Geometry Ideals Are Strictly Realizable Ample
scope: Finite nonempty binary classes and their one-inclusion graphs.
statement: Every convex-geometry ideal is realizable ample, but the agreeing-blocks class is realizable ample and is not a convex-geometry ideal.
proof: Convex-geometry ideals admit the standard qualitative realization. The agreeing-blocks class has a positive geometric realization, while its positive Horn-renaming defect excludes every conditional-antimatroid orientation and therefore every convex-geometry-ideal presentation.
